recipe_coverage: Reviewed sweep component on both sides of a mixed board, with overlapping permanent types, colors, flying, indestructible witnesses, tapped/untapped variants, empty boards/zones, populated libraries/graveyards/exile, exact normal payment and snapshot/AI replay. Additional Oracle clauses (alternate costs, cycling, flashback, awaken, uncounterability, regeneration prohibition, planeswalker scope) require separate authored cases where present. Graveyards and exile are checked by ownership and contents rather than arbitrary simultaneous-death order. Ordinary cycling component only, through the real hand-ability proxy/menu. Explicit pinned cycling cost, both players, discard and payment before stack resolution, ordered draws and multiplicities, independent copies, cancellation/insufficient or wrong mana, combat/opposing turn, own/opposing cost reduction and taxes, pending/resolved snapshots after AI backups, and reclaim/exile of the discarded source while the draw is pending. Cast effects, battlefield abilities and multiplayer remain gaps. Additional cycling/discard triggers, nonstandard cycling costs and alternate hand/graveyard mechanics are excluded.
